indicator_definition: Share of material recovered and reused as a proportion of overall material use. Indicates progress towards a circular economy. Compiled by Eurostat from waste and material flow statistics.
rationale: Increasing circular material use reduces extraction, waste and environmental pressures. Progress means an increasing circular material use rate.
methodology_characteristics: Calculated as recycled waste used as raw material inputs divided by overall material use. Compiled by Eurostat annually from waste statistics and material flow accounts.
